# SPDX-License-Identifier: EPL-2.0
name: Nebula M3 final proven transfer

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'm3/**'
      - '.m3/**'
      - 'pom.xml'
      - '.github/workflows/m3-final-proven-transfer.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  prove:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
          cache: maven

      - name: Set up Maven 3.9.6
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@07fbbe97d97ef44336b7382563d66743297e442f
        with:
          maven-version: 3.9.6

      - name: 1 - Diff hygiene
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --check "$BASE_SHA...HEAD"

      - name: 2 - Compile and test complete M3 source-first reactor
        run: mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml verify

      - name: 3 - Prove canonical convergence and transfer contract tests
        run: >-
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml
          -pl recipe-first -am
          -Dtest=NebulaM3Java21ConvergenceRecipeTest,NebulaM3RecipeDagManifestTest,NebulaM3RecipeDagManifestCliTest,NebulaM3OrchestratorPlansTest,NebulaM3TransferContractTest,NebulaM3PureIntConvergenceRecipeTest,NebulaM3A3LabTest
          -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
          test

      - name: 4 - Enforce 99 percent semantic recipe coverage
        run: >-
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml
          -pl recipe-first -am
          -Psemantic-coverage
          -Dtest=NebulaM3Java21ConvergenceRecipeTest,NebulaM3OrchestratorPlansTest,NebulaM3PureIntConvergenceRecipeTest
          -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
          verify

      - name: 5 - Export scheduler-neutral DAG and portable transfer receipt
        run: mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml -Pdag-manifest -Ptransfer-contract verify

      - name: 6 - Assert transfer and orchestration authority
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT='m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-transfer'
          DAG='m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag'
          test -s "$OUT/transfer.sha256"
          test -s "$OUT/transfer-dag.tsv"
          test -s "$DAG/recipe-dag.sha256"
          test -s "$OUT/camel-route.yaml"
          test -s "$OUT/airflow-dag.py"
          test -s "$OUT/drools-agenda.drl"
          test -s "$OUT/orchestrator-plans.sha256"
          test -s "$DAG/camel-route.yaml"
          test -s "$DAG/airflow-dag.py"
          test -s "$DAG/drools-agenda.drl"
          test -s "$DAG/orchestrator-plans.sha256"
          grep -F $'schema\tNEBULA_M3_RECIPE_TRANSFER_V1' "$OUT/transfer-metadata.tsv"
          grep -F $'javaRelease\t21' "$OUT/transfer-metadata.tsv"
          grep -F $'entrypoint\torg.eclipse.nebula.m3.rewrite.NebulaM3Java21ConvergenceRecipe' "$OUT/transfer-metadata.tsv"
          grep -F $'hsoliwal/M3jdk21\tJAVA21_JDK_COMPATIBILITY_AND_BACKPORT_LANES\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/transfer-targets.tsv"
          grep -F $'hsoliwal/com.synexia\tRECIPE_PACK_AND_MODULE_LANES\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/transfer-targets.tsv"
          grep -F $'MAVEN_OPENREWRITE\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/orchestrators.tsv"
          grep -F $'CAMEL\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/orchestrators.tsv"
          grep -F $'AIRFLOW\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/orchestrators.tsv"
          grep -F $'DROOLS\tfalse\tfalse' "$OUT/orchestrators.tsv"
          PLAN_ROOT="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$OUT/orchestrator-plans.sha256")"
          test "$PLAN_ROOT" = "$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$DAG/orchestrator-plans.sha256")"
          grep -F $'orchestratorPlansRoot\t'"$PLAN_ROOT" "$OUT/transfer-metadata.tsv"
          grep -F 'direct:nebula-m3-openrewrite-atom' "$OUT/camel-route.yaml"
          grep -F 'M3RecipeNode' "$OUT/drools-agenda.drl"
          python3 -m py_compile "$OUT/airflow-dag.py"

      - name: 7 - Inventory complete Nebula Java checkout
        run: >-
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml -Pinventory
          -Dm3.nebula.out="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-inventory"
          verify

      - name: 8 - Require zero Java parse failures
        run: grep -F $'failureRows\t0' m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-inventory/nebula-m3-summary.tsv

      - name: 9 - Install the tested Nebula recipe artifact
        run: mvn -B -ntp -f m3/reactor.xml install

      - name: 10 - Apply FILE-local recipe DAG and capture first candidate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT='m3/recipe-first/target/final-transfer-proof'
          mkdir -p "$OUT"
          git diff --exit-code
          mvn -B -ntp -Pm3-local-file-convergence -DskipMavenParsing=true \
            org.openrewrite.maven:rewrite-maven-plugin:6.46.1:runNoFork
          git diff --check
          git diff --name-only | sort > "$OUT/changed-files.txt"
          test -s "$OUT/changed-files.txt"
          unexpected="$(grep -Ev '\.java$' "$OUT/changed-files.txt" || true)"
          if [[ -n "$unexpected" ]]; then
            printf 'FILE recipe escaped Java source scope:\n%s\n' "$unexpected"
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --binary > "$OUT/first.patch"

      - name: 11 - Prove complete recipe DAG fixed point
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT='m3/recipe-first/target/final-transfer-proof'
          mvn -B -ntp -Pm3-local-file-convergence -DskipMavenParsing=true \
            org.openrewrite.maven:rewrite-maven-plugin:6.46.1:runNoFork
          git diff --check
          git diff --binary > "$OUT/second.patch"
          diff -u "$OUT/first.patch" "$OUT/second.patch"

      - name: 12 - Original Nebula Tycho reactor on transformed candidate tree
        run: xvfb-run -a mvn -V -B -ntp clean verify -Dtycho.localArtifacts=ignore

      - name: 13 - Preserve candidate-only authority
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only --cached)"
          grep -F 'source.promotion=false' .m3/atom-pattern/policy.properties
          grep -F 'java.localCandidatePromotion=false' .m3/atom-pattern/policy.properties
          grep -F $'8\tFILE_FIXED_POINT' m3/convergence/PLAN.tsv

      - name: Upload final proof and transfer artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nebula-m3-final-proven-transfer
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-transfer/
            m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-dag/
            m3/recipe-first/target/nebula-m3-inventory/
            m3/recipe-first/target/final-transfer-proof/
            m3/recipe-first/target/site/jacoco/
            **/target/surefire-reports/
            m3/convergence/PLAN.tsv
            .m3/atom-pattern/policy.properties
